import importlib.util
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
script = Path('.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py')
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), 'report', 'input.md', 'output.md', '--scope=content', '--level=3', '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
report = json.loads(result.stdout)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('adhd_md', script)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
original = Path('input.md').read_text()
revised = Path('output.md').read_text()
def signature(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    return {
        'line_count': len(lines),
        'blank_lines': [i for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1) if not line],
        'blocks': [(b.kind, b.start, b.end) for b in module.Doc(text).blocks],
        'heading_levels': [len(m.group(1)) for line in lines if (m := re.match(r'"'^(#{1,6}) '"', line))],
        'list_markers': [m.group(1) for line in lines if (m := re.match(r'"'^('"\\s*\\d+\\.) ', line))],
        'markup': re.findall(r'\\*\\*|__|"'`|<details>|</details>|<summary>|</summary>'"', text),
        'ends_with_single_newline': text.endswith('\\n') and not text.endswith('\\n\\n'),
    }
old_layout, new_layout = signature(original), signature(revised)
assert old_layout == new_layout, (old_layout, new_layout)
report['layout_check'] = {'status': 'pass', 'before': old_layout, 'after': new_layout}
report['m_group_findings'] = {side: sum(item['rule'].startswith('M') for item in report[side]['findings']) for side in ('before', 'after')}
